final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause was the vendored `slugify`, which strips any character outside `a-z0-9`, so accented letters were dropped entirely. Since `vendor/` is off-limits, I fixed it in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now decomposes the title (`normalize('NFD')`) and removes the combining accent marks before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call the vendored `slugify` directly, so they still drop accented letters. I left them alone because you only asked about the blog. The proper fix for both is in the vendored package, which the platform team would need to upgrade.
